newsitem.title: USA: Florida puts $6.31 mln regents issue on notice.
newsitem.headline: Florida puts $6.31 mln regents issue on notice.

text.p: Florida will sell $6.31 million state Board of Regents revenue bonds by competitive bid with 20 hours notice, the state Division of Bond Finance said.
The issue is Board of Regents Florida Agricultural and Mechanical University Student Services Center Revenue Bonds, Se ries 1997.
The issue has maturities out to 2017 and will fund construction of a student services center at the Florida A&M campus in Tallahassee.
